label: Camera
note: How the shot moves — written in H3 motion-primitive + amplitude + speed language.

options.label: 🎬 Multi-Angle Close/Medium Action Coverage (3-Shot Cut — Tight on Action)
options.rule: a three-shot multi-angle close-and-medium action sequence with every shot cropped tight on the physical interaction keeping tight close-up and medium action framing throughout: [Shot 1] opens in a tight close-medium angle focused directly on the opening posture and action; [Shot 2] cuts on the midpoint beat to a low-angle side medium close-up capturing the torso, hands and hip/body mechanics up close; [Shot 3] cuts in the final third to a steep high-angle 3/4 top-down or first-person POV close-up locked on the climax of the action.
options.aspect_tip: 📐 RESOLUTION: Works in both 📱 9:16 Portrait (768×1344, best for solo/vertical stacking) and 🖥️ 16:9 Landscape (1344×768, best for multi-subject/wide horizontal blocking).
options.duration_tip: ⏱ BEST LENGTH: 6–12 s (141–294f) — Standard H3 motion window (minimum 124f / 5.2s for clear camera travel).

options.label: 🔥 Multi-Position 3-Shot Intimate Cut (Wide/Medium -> Tight Contact -> Contrasting Climax)
options.rule: a three-shot multi-position intimate camera sequence adapting cleanly to the active stage, subjects, and wardrobe across cuts: [Shot 1] opens in a medium or three-quarter two-shot establishing full body positions, screen-left and screen-right placement, and active setting; [Shot 2] cuts to a tight low-angle or steep high-angle close-up locked onto hands, faces, and physical contact; [Shot 3] cuts to a contrasting angle and framing scale capturing peak motion and climax while carrying forward sticky displaced clothing and lighting.
options.aspect_tip: 📐 RESOLUTION: Works in both 📱 9:16 Portrait (768×1344, best for solo/vertical stacking) and 🖥️ 16:9 Landscape (1344×768, best for multi-subject/wide horizontal blocking).

options.rule: open framed low behind a foreground railing or table edge, then physically pedestal up smoothly with large amplitude to clear the barrier and reveal the full scene

options.label: LoopForge Subject Walk-Past Lens Transition
options.rule: hold steady on a crisp stationary framing as the character strides closely past the lens foreground edge and exits smoothly into depth

options.label: 🚗 Buckle-Up Car Cabin Mount (Rigid Interior, World Streaks Past)
options.rule: camera locked inside the car cabin beside the subjects so the seats, steering wheel, and faces remain tack-sharp while headlights, neon signage, and road geometry streak smoothly past the side windows

options.label: 🏎️ Car Chasing Pursuit Rig (Matched Speed Line-of-Action)
options.rule: low pursuit tracking shot gliding from a chasing vehicle at matched highway speed, locking both vehicles along one line of action as asphalt, guardrails, and sparks whip underneath

options.label: 🚘 Exterior Hood / Door Grip Mount (Chrome & Asphalt Speed)
options.rule: exterior chassis-mounted lens framing painted metal hood or door chrome rigidly in the near foreground while wet asphalt streaks backward beneath and the driver stays visible through the windshield

options.label: 👀 Wandering Curiosity Drift (Searching Handheld Float)
options.rule: gentle unhurried handheld float drifting curiously past foreground silhouettes, tables, and warm practical lamps across the room before smoothly landing onto the main subject

options.label: 📐 Short-Siding Pressure Framing (Face Pressed Toward Edge)
options.rule: tense asymmetrical composition placing the speaker close to the frame edge they face toward with broad open room space stretching behind their shoulders

options.label: 🪟 Voyeur Concealed Frame (Peering Past Foliage / Blinds)
options.rule: distant concealed viewpoint peering softly past slightly out-of-focus foreground blinds, doorway jamb, or window glass onto the illuminated subjects deeper inside the room

options.label: ⭕ Graphic Match Cut (Matching Circular/Linear Geometry Cut)
options.rule: two-shot graphic match cut: [Shot 1] centers a distinct circular or vertical geometric shape moving cleanly in frame; [Shot 2] cuts smoothly onto a matching shape at the identical screen position

options.label: ⚡ Smash Cut Contrast (Quiet Pause -> Sudden Energy Shift)
options.rule: high-contrast two-shot smash cut: [Shot 1] holds a calm, still close framing in soft room tone; [Shot 2] smash-cuts sharply into immediate kinetic motion and crisp ambient impact

options.label: 🎵 Beat-Snap Micro Push-In (Syncs Zoom/Dolly Pulses to Dance/Action Hits)
options.rule: Execute a smooth forward dolly push-in accented by crisp, subtle micro-pushes timed directly to major dance pops or beat drops, keeping subject centered from medium-full into tight chest-up framing.

options.label: 💃 Low-Angle Idol Pedestal Rise (Boots-to-Eyes Glamour Sweep)
options.rule: Open low near floor level framing footwear and lower silhouette, then pedestal smoothly upward at steady speed tracing legs, waist, and torso before settling cleanly at eye-level medium close-up.

options.label: 📱 Handheld Vertical Dance Follow (Natural Operator Groove & Micro-Sway)
options.rule: Track fluidly with an agile handheld gimbal/camera that breathes gently with the performer's footwork, stepping subtly forward on choruses and easing back on wide spins.

options.label: 🌀 360° Slow-Motion Two-Subject Orbit (Full Circle Around Duo)
options.rule: Glide smoothly in a continuous 360-degree circular orbit around both subjects at waist-to-chest height with steady speed, revealing foreground-to-background parallax and shifting rim light.

options.label: 🪞 Mirror-Reflection Rack-Focus Pull (Real Foreground -> Crisp Glass Reflection)
options.rule: Open with crisp focus on the subject's real shoulder and silhouette in the near foreground while the mirror reflection glows softly out of focus, then pull focus smoothly into the mirror plane to reveal sharp facial expression.

options.label: ⚡ Whip-Pan Beat-Snap Transition (Fast Horizontal Blur -> Locked Reveal)
options.rule: [Shot 1] holds steady medium framing for the opening beat before whipping horizontally left-to-right into crisp blur; [Shot 2] snaps out of the horizontal whip pan onto a locked contrasting angle and pose

options.label: 🔥 Sensual Contour Glide (Slow Tight Arc Tracing Shoulder, Waist & Hip)
options.rule: Arc slowly and closely along a three-quarter front-to-side path at moderate amplitude, keeping shallow depth of field focused cleanly across collarbone, waist curve, and hip movement.

options.label: 🚘 Car-Window Exterior-to-Cabin Glide (Passing Glass Reflections -> Interior)
options.rule: Open tracking beside the rain-beaded car side window catching passing neon reflections, then glide smoothly inward through the open window frame into a tight intimate cabin two-shot.

options.label: 🎬 Viral Dance Montage Cuts (Distant Dutch Zoom -> 90° Hand Wipe -> Solo -> L-Gun -> Wide Drop -> Punch-In)
options.rule: Open in a distant 15-degree Dutch-tilted wide shot zooming inward while rolling upright into a forward popping V-split, hard-cut to a 90-degree rolled diagonal reach, hard-cut onto an isolated bare diagonal hand highlight across background water, hard-cut to a quick solo close-up zoom, hard-cut onto tight cheek-to-cheek L-sign finger-guns, smash far out to a distant wide full-body master for synchronized hops and groove, and hard-cut cleanly into a thigh-up sensual finale.

options.label: ⚡ Beat-Drop Punch-Out Wide -> Medium Ending-Fairy Track
options.rule: [Shot 1] opens tight waist-up building pre-drop tension with micro beat-synced push-ins; [Shot 2] smash-cuts instantaneously out into a crisp wide full-body master frame on the bass drop for full footwork and kicks; [Shot 3] cuts smoothly inward onto chest-up ending-fairy smiles.

options.label: 🖐️ Palm-Over-Lens Wipe -> Instant Whip-Reveal Tracking
options.rule: [Shot 1] opens handheld medium-close as the dancer sweeps an open palm directly across the lens glass; [Shot 2] snaps cleanly away in a fast whip-reveal tracking angle locked onto explosive full-body choreography and forward struts.

options.label: 🦶 Low Floor Hero Track (Frames Deep Squats & Soaring High Kicks)
options.rule: Ride low near shin height angled slightly upward with spacious headroom so deep synchronized squats read low and athletic while soaring overhead high kicks slice dramatically across the bright sky or ceiling lights.

options.label: ✂️ Distant Wide Master (Half-Height) -> Instant Hard Cut Thigh-Up
options.rule: [Shot 1] opens in a distant wide establishing shot framing full figures at roughly half frame height with generous floor and sky headroom for explosive footwork and lateral travel; [Shot 2] fires an instant hard cut straight into a close medium thigh-up two-shot or solo payoff.

options.label: 🌀 15° Dutch Wide Zoom-In -> Upright Level Reveal
options.rule: Open in a distant 15-degree Dutch-tilted wide shot zooming briskly inward while rolling smoothly upright to dead-level horizon right as subjects reveal and snap onto the beat.

options.label: ⚡ Fight Whip-Track -> Low Sweep -> Mid-Air Tilt -> Snap Zoom Ultimate
options.rule: Keep camera motion fast, snappy, and urgent throughout: dart laterally with punches, drop low near floor height on crouching leg sweeps, tilt sharply upward following jump kicks and mid-air clashes, snap-zoom rapidly inward onto the ultimate attack in the next-to-last beat, and whip wide across crash debris in the final beat.

options.label: 🎬 K-Pop Gimbal Push-Shake & Fingertip-Motivated Drop
options.rule: Run a dynamic 28mm handheld gimbal chasing the idol's hands: push straight inward toward outstretched fingertips, drop sharply downward with a tight micro-shake the instant fingers curl or strike down, whip laterally in the direction a pointed index finger leads, and rise smoothly onto a hero chorus wide frame.

options.label: 🔳 K-Pop Arm-Window Peek & Precision Aspect Snap-Zoom
options.rule: Open locked closely behind or opposite a front performer's geometric 90-degree bent-arm window framing the partner's eyes and fingertips inside the forearm rectangle, punch cleanly through the wrist box on the beat drop into tight twin eye-level close-ups, and snap back wide on synchronized hand locks.

options.label: 🚪 K-Pop Lateral Match-Truck Scene Wipe & Styling Snap-Cut
options.rule: Drive a brisk continuous horizontal lateral truck past a clean vertical pillar or doorway wipe, hard-cutting at peak speed directly into a matched dance pose inside a fresh contrasting lighting setup while the dancer's motion carries smoothly through the transition.

options.label: 🤏 K-Pop Fingertip-Macro Anti-Drop Freeze -> Crane Boom-Out
options.rule: Open tightly framed on fingertips and eyes locked in an intricate geometric tutting box beside the cheek, hold dead-still through a split-second anti-drop micro-freeze, then whip-boom rapidly backward and high onto a sweeping overhead crane arc as full-body footwork explodes wide.

options.label: 🎬 K-Pop Studio-Choom Crimson Dolly Push & Strobe Beat-Snap
options.rule: Glide smoothly along a low 24mm track dolly pushing from waist level toward the performer's upper torso beneath vivid colored studio backlight, snap dead-still for a crisp anti-drop beat freeze as key lighting switches sharply from cool ice-cyan to saturated crimson, then glide rapidly wide again as synchronized footwork breaks across the reflective floor.

options.label: 🌀 K-Pop Overhead Halo Corkscrew Drop -> Eye-Level Lens Grab
options.rule: Open centered straight overhead looking downward onto symmetrical star-and-diamond arm geometry, spiral rapidly downward in a smooth corkscrew descent matching the performer's spinning shoulders down to eye level, and lock tight inches from outstretched fingertips reaching straight toward the glass.
